name: code_exchange
description: Code each numbered target unit independently, following the coding prompt. Return one entry per unit in "units", tagged with its unit_index as shown in [unit_index N]. Each target unit is one speaking turn and may begin with a timestamp showing the elapsed time since the conversation started (e.g., [00:12]); use it to apply the first-15-seconds rule for NC [D2.6]. Categorize each speaking turn and provide a rationale.

unit_index.description: Index of the target unit this entry codes, as shown in [unit_index N] in the message.

category.description: The code for this speaking turn, as defined in the coding prompt [D1-D6] and chosen under the precedence rules [CR4]. Do not assign NC to a speaking turn whose timestamp is earlier than 00:15 [D2.6].

rationale.description: One to three sentences that walk through how you reached the code, citing the bracketed label of each prompt part at the point where you rely on it. Example: 'Given that the speaking turn is on topic [CR2(a)] and blames the partner's behavior in general terms [D4.1, D4.2], and since the exaggeration blames behavior rather than undermining an idea [D6.5], the correct code is B, with ID (EX) as an alternative [CR4(b)].' Do not simply list labels at the end.

subcategory.description: Optional. When category is ID, the ID subcategory that applies, using the labels the prompt gives (HQ, HJ, MR, DR, EX) [D6.1-D6.5]. If more than one applies, follow CR4(e). Null otherwise.

alternatives_considered.description: Codes that were close but not chosen, including IN, NC or an ID subcategory set aside under the precedence rules [CR4]. Empty array if none.
